channel.title: AI GridWatch — Michigan data center updates
channel.description: Data center moratoriums, proposals, and community-impact headlines for Michigan, from AI GridWatch.

item.title: Allendale Township: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Ordinance 2026-07, one-year moratorium on data centers, battery storage, large-scale solar, and wind farms. Township board voted to study and implement ordinance revisions.

item.title: Big Rapids Charter Township: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: One-year moratorium on permitting, consideration, approval, location, construction, and installation of data center facilities.

item.title: Caledonia Township: data center moratorium — Expired
item.description: Six-month moratorium on data center and data mining operations, backdated to Jan 1 2026. Prompted by developer inquiries about property at 68th Street and Kraft Avenue.

item.title: Detroit: data center moratorium — Proposed
item.description: City Council voted 6-2 for a resolution asking Mayor Sheffield to impose a two-year moratorium on data center permits. The mayor has not adopted it, instead convening a stakeholder working group with a Dec 31, 2026 deadline for policy recommendations.

item.title: Fenton Township: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Ordinance No. 867, twelve-month moratorium to allow the Township Board and Planning Commission to evaluate and prepare permanent zoning regulations for data centers.

item.title: Filer Township: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: One-year moratorium on data center development. Public comment raised concerns about water usage, energy requirements, noise, and demolition plans.

item.title: Haring Township: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Six-month moratorium on construction of data centers, approved unanimously. Planning commission directed to develop permanent regulatory standards. Key concerns: water usage, noise pollution, privacy, property tax impacts.

item.title: Hart: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: City Council unanimously adopted six-month moratorium on data centers and digital mining uses. Described as proactive rather than a response to a specific proposal.

item.title: Lincoln Township: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 10-month moratorium on data center development. Allows planning commission time to study noise, water and electrical consumption, and community impacts.

item.title: Lowell Township: data center moratorium — Rejected
item.description: Township Board voted 2-5 against a proposed six-month moratorium. Proposed in response to Microsoft's plans for a data center at the 237-acre Covenant Business Park. Rejection prompted recall petitions for three board members.

item.title: Lyndon Township: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Resolution 26-06, 12-month moratorium on issuance of permits, licenses, or approvals for data centers, or until permanent regulations adopted.

item.title: Lyon Charter Township: data center moratorium — Expired
item.description: 180-day moratorium on data centers and all proposed developments over 100,000 sq ft, unanimous. Prompted by backlash over 'Project Flex' — a 1.8M-sq-ft Verrus data center on 172 acres approved by planning commission in Sep 2025. The already-approved project is not affected.

item.title: Orion Township: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Board passed a six-month moratorium 7-0 at the request of the planning commission and planning/zoning department, which said the current zoning ordinance does not address modern data centers. Resolution covers facilities housing computer systems, servers, telecommunications equipment and data storage. Supervisor cited water and power usage; township may extend it.

item.title: Delta County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 12-month moratorium on data centers and cryptocurrency mining; county board approved unanimously after planning commission forwarded recommendation; county to develop zoning standards during pause

item.title: Forsyth Township: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 12-month moratorium on data center construction; board passed at crowded meeting; township lacks data center zoning regulations and has no pending applications

item.title: Houghton: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: One-year moratorium on permitting, approval, or installation of data center facilities; city council voted unanimously; no proposals pending but city acted proactively to develop regulations

item.title: Huron County: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Three-year (36-month) moratorium on data centers; planning commission unanimously extended original 6-month proposal to 36 months at April 1 hearing after public demand; county commissioners approved in May; concerns center on farmland preservation and resource use

item.title: Sault Ste. Marie Tribe of Chippewa Indians: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Indefinite moratorium prohibiting development, approval, or operation of AI data centers on tribal lands; board of directors voted unanimously; remains in effect unless lifted by subsequent resolution; concerns about resource strain and long-term land use impacts

item.title: Saugatuck Township: data center moratorium — Expired
item.description: Ordinance 2026-01: 6-month moratorium on data center building permits and zoning applications, or until zoning amendment adopted. Voted 4-0 (one absent)

item.title: Hagar Township: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Moratorium on data centers approved at board meeting; Berrien County. Source is paywalled but headline and snippets confirm

item.title: Lake Township: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Ordinance 2026-01: temporary moratorium on new or expanded data centers. Voted 4-0 (clerk absent). Huron County township; separate from county-level 3-year moratorium

item.title: Webster Township: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Ordinance 26-02: 1-year moratorium on data centers and battery energy storage systems (BESS). Washtenaw County township

item.title: Allen Park: data center moratorium — Proposed
item.description: Planning commission rejected 26MW data center; city council considering 6-month moratorium on data center developments as of June 2026. No confirmed vote on moratorium yet.

item.title: Genoa Township: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Board of Trustees approved a one-time 6-month extension of the moratorium on data centers and cryptocurrency mining facilities. Additional time needed for noise restriction provisions. This is Genoa Township in Livingston County, MI — not Ohio.

item.title: Lansing: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Lansing City Council passed 182-day moratorium on Jul 14, 2026 (7-1 vote). Takes effect Jul 27, lasts until Jan 25, 2027. Pauses new building permits and zoning applications for data centers. Follows withdrawal of Deep Green AI proposal for downtown data center.

item.title: Michigan (HB 5594-5596): data center moratorium — Proposed
item.description: HB 5594-5596 (House) and companion SB 1018-1020 (Senate) introduced June 2026. Data Center Regulation Act would halt new data center permits until Apr 1, 2027. Bipartisan sponsors (Reps. Wortz R, Fox R, Wegela D). In House Committee on Government Operations. Governor Whitmer has explicitly stated she would veto any moratorium legislation.

item.title: Zeeland Township: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: Township Board unanimously approved new 1-year moratorium on data centers and energy facilities, replacing a previous moratorium that was repealed at the same meeting. Provides time to review and update master plan.

item.title: Lenox Township: data center moratorium — Expired
item.description: 4-month moratorium effective Feb 2, 2026 with one 4-month extension option; the township's adoption statement has since been removed from its site. The Jun 1, 2026 board agenda carried no extension item, so whether the option was exercised is unrecorded

item.title: Garfield Township: data center moratorium — Enacted
item.description: 1-year moratorium on data centers and cryptocurrency mining facilities, unanimous, to allow a zoning-ordinance update; township policy allows a further 6-month extension if the update isn't finished, which is not yet in effect
